description: Six private copies of emit_job_diagnostic (quoted_expander, world, jobs/{types,dispatch,body,contract}) and nine inline 'emit_through(one diagnostic); FatalError' sites (jobs/{native,artifact x2,backend,root,semantic x3}, backend_program/boxed_contract) answer one question: a job reports one diagnostic and fails. One pub(crate) emit_job_diagnostic lives in compiler2::drive beside FatalError and JobEffects; every copy and inline site calls it. contract.rs's ()-returning copy served report-and-continue sites (a diagnosed @spec constrains nothing); those call emit_through directly.
title: One emit_job_diagnostic: a job that reports and fails says so in one place
